messages:
Nick: Quick check — before I schedule the full perf run, can we agree on TTFT definition? I want TTFT = server time to first byte excluding network + tokenizer time. Thoughts?
Anya: +1 for including tokenizer time; but we should tag whether it's cold vs warm cache. Also batch size affects kv cache hit, mention batch profile.
Kevin: Agreed. Propose fields: ttft_server_ms, tokenizer_ms, client_to_server_ms (optional). p95 should be measured on warm steady-state and cold-start separately.
Nick: Cool. I'll add to dashboard. Also need someone to own the bench for 40B quantized model. Who can take the run next Tue?
Olivia: I can take the 40B quant run. Need the exact config though — can you paste the bench yaml?
Nick: Here —
```yaml
model: llama-40b-quant
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
sequence_lengths: [64,256,1024]
cache_state: [cold,warm]
metrics: [ttft_server_ms, tokens_per_second, p95]
```
Olivia: Perfect. I'll kick off on Tue morning and post perf-bot results.
perf-bot: Run scheduled by Olivia for 1849050000. Results will be posted in thread when complete :rocket:
Anya: Also pinging @Ryan for dashboard mapping — need new panels for tokenizer_ms and a split by cache_state.
Ryan: Got it — I'll add panels and annotate the canary run. ETA EOD Wed.
Kevin: Small ask — when you post results include the raw histogram for p95 so we can eyeball skew.
Olivia: Will do. If we see regression I'll open a tiny bisect PR and cc eng-runtime.
Nick: Thanks team. I'll update the metric doc and link to this thread.
